Atrium Player Box Score

Source: R/atrium.R
atrium_box_score.Rd

One game's box score: one row per rostered player with the statistics the site configures.

Endpoint: GET https://embed-api.eui.connect.sportradar.com/v1/embed/{website_id}/fixture_detail?sub=statistics

A player who did not play has participated FALSE and NA statistics. LNB has blocks_received and plus_minus but no field-goal totals; LNBP the reverse. minutes is the ISO duration as sent and seconds_played its value. Percentages are 0-100. side is home or away.

Usage

atrium_box_score(website_id, fixture_id, locale = NULL)

Arguments

website_id

(integer required): Site config id: which league site's widget this is (12 LNB France, 14 LNBP Mexico, 3 NBL1 Australia, 13 El Salvador, 22 Panama, 236 Austria, 326 Montenegro). Not a league id: one site serves several competitions.

fixture_id

(character required): Game UUID (fixture_id in atrium_fixtures()), e.g. "0dc631bd-c34c-11f1-8d16-4d5a21afb79d".

locale

(character optional): Locale of the labels, e.g. "en-EN" or "fr-FR". Omitted = the site's own language. Ids and codes never change.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble with one row per (fixture_id, person_id). Its columns are listed in return_columns (subset(return_columns, fn == "atrium_box_score")) and in the searchable return columns article.

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in atrium_fixtures().

See also

Other Atrium Functions: atrium_competition_player_stats(), atrium_competition_team_stats(), atrium_end_year(), atrium_fixture(), atrium_fixture_periods(), atrium_fixtures(), atrium_fixtures_ribbon(), atrium_leaders(), atrium_pbp(), atrium_player(), atrium_player_game_log(), atrium_player_seasons(), atrium_player_stats(), atrium_players(), atrium_season_id(), atrium_seasons(), atrium_shots(), atrium_standings(), atrium_standings_summary(), atrium_team(), atrium_team_box_score(), atrium_team_stats(), atrium_teams(), lmb_competition, lnb_competition, lnbp_competition, lpb_competition, nbl1_competition
